title: 脳生理データ解析演習
subtitle: Analysis of Brain and Physiological Data
educationalGoal: In recent years, there has been an increase in the use of various measurement devices in psychology to obtain physiological and brain measurements. The data obtained from these measurements are characterized by a large number of data points, time series, and multiple channels compared to traditional psychological experimental data. In this course, we will focus on some types of brain and physiological measurement data that are commonly used in psychological research and aim to learn the basics of analyzing these data.
advice: The course will cover the fundamentals of data processing using the basic functions of R and a variety of analysis methods, primarily through hands-on exercises. This is not a class for just listening to lectures, so please be willing to work on it.
requiredKnowledge: R will be used, so be sure to have it installed before the class starts.

activityGoals.body: Be able to run the statistical analyses with R.
Be able to visualize data with R.
Be able to choose an adequate analyzing tool with data.
Be able to use effectively various analyzing tools implemented in R.

              In recent years, there has been an increase in the use of various measurement devices in psychology to obtain physiological and brain measurements. The data obtained from these measurements are characterized by a large number of data points, time series, and multiple channels compared to traditional psychological experimental data. In this course, we will focus on some types of brain and physiological measurement data that are commonly used in psychological research and aim to learn the basics of analyzing these data.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              The course will cover the fundamentals of data processing using the basic functions of R and a variety of analysis methods, primarily through hands-on exercises. This is not a class for just listening to lectures, so please be willing to work on it.
